It's not clear enough for people to explain mission will instantly fail as soon as meter hits 70%. Even tho Archimedian Yonta tells people to extract but still they do not get it.
The challange it self is good not that hard. But open squad warframe players are do not give a shit about objectives, they look for others to take care of it. For 200 level mission I can't take it alone by killing eximus units and gathering vitoplast to full fill the objective at the same time. I play with open squads but they really not into it, every mission is going to fail at second tor thrid rotation if this challange is active.

I really do not care about what people do during missions, but I'd like to question what people do, read or pay attention during playing this game if their actions will fail my mission.
